command:
cd /app && python - <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('tests/functional/test_functional.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    def test_nosec(self):
        expect = {
            "SEVERITY": {"UNDEFINED": 0, "LOW": 5, "MEDIUM": 0, "HIGH": 0},
            "CONFIDENCE": {"UNDEFINED": 0, "LOW": 0, "MEDIUM": 0, "HIGH": 5},
        }
        self.check_example("nosec.py", expect)
'''
new = '''    def test_nosec(self):
        expect = {
            "SEVERITY": {"UNDEFINED": 0, "LOW": 5, "MEDIUM": 0, "HIGH": 0},
            "CONFIDENCE": {"UNDEFINED": 0, "LOW": 0, "MEDIUM": 0, "HIGH": 5},
        }
        self.check_example("nosec.py", expect)

    def test_nosec_region_directives(self):
        expect = {
            "SEVERITY": {"UNDEFINED": 0, "LOW": 2, "MEDIUM": 0, "HIGH": 0},
            "CONFIDENCE": {"UNDEFINED": 0, "LOW": 0, "MEDIUM": 0, "HIGH": 2},
        }
        expect_metrics = {
            "nosec": 2,
            "skipped_tests": 2,
        }
        self.check_example("nosec-region.py", expect)
        self.check_metrics("nosec-region.py", expect_metrics)
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(s)
print("done")
EOF
cd /app && python -m unittest tests.functional.test_functional.FunctionalTests.test_nosec_region_directives -v 2>&1 | tail -15
